Turn your codebase into a queryable knowledge graph. Trace dependencies, understand how components connect, and give your coding agent reusable context across sessions. Start free, no card required →  ·  Graphify Cloud keeps that graph always-on across your whole SDLC. Type `/graphify` in your AI coding assistant and it maps your entire project (code, docs, PDFs, images, videos) into a knowledge graph you can query instead of grepping through files. - Code maps for free, fully local. Code is parsed with tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, nothing leaves your machine. (Docs, PDFs, images and video use your assistant's model, or a configured API key, for a semantic pass.) - Every edge is explained. Each connection is tagged `EXTRACTED` (explicit in the source) or `INFERRED` (resolved by graphify), so you can tell what was read directly from what was inferred. - Not a vector index.
